supporting_scaling_authority.head: f2d5cd8d0e69a35436573f6d32dd0916c344ca49
supporting_scaling_authority.role: external immutable supporting authority; not copied into this branch

purpose: Construct a casewise candidate-blind REF-HIGH authority using a formula-derived total-balance representation floor, while keeping the D1 compartment scaling and the original P2E18 endpoint-stability budgets unchanged.

REPRESENTATION_FLOOR.rationale: For any accepted theta within (theta_r,theta_s), half the sum of pre/post representation spacings per cell is bounded by spacing(theta_s); multiplying by dz and summing yields a prospective integrated storage-representation bound without using observed D3 residual ratios.

stability_budgets.source: original frozen P2E18 budgets derived as 0.10 x P2E14 for head/theta and full P2E14 storage floor

casewise_ref_high_rule.required_stability: all five metrics pass for both 8_vs_16 and 16_vs_32
casewise_ref_high_rule.policy_neutrality: Where INTEGRATED_INVARIANT and REPRESENTATION_FLOOR are both valid at the same fine level, their endpoints must remain inside the same frozen stability budget. Any neutrality failure blocks that case.
casewise_ref_high_rule.minimum_for_any_future_E3: At least one prospectively qualified case; E3 must state the exact qualified case set and may not substitute unresolved cases.

outcome_policy.if_nonempty_subset_qualified: Persist casewise REF-HIGH authority for exactly the qualified cases and list every unresolved case/reason. This is not a failure and does not authorize replacing cases.
outcome_policy.if_zero_qualified: REF-HIGH remains blocked and E3 cannot proceed.

nonclaims: This is a research-only numerical-reference policy, not a proposed production Reference tolerance change.
A qualified 32-substep endpoint is a numerical reference for the bounded E3 subset, not physical truth.
No RossFast accuracy, speed or equal-error result is generated here.
